title: Quoting Zach Kehs
summary: If you continue to add floors and rooms to a building forever, it will collapse. Software faces no such constraint. The code can always get worse. There can always be a new layer of indirection or a reduction in performance. — Zach Kehs , There's No Limit to How Bad Code Can Get Tags: technical-debt
body:
If you continue to add floors and rooms to a building forever, it will collapse. Software faces no such constraint. The code can always get worse. There can always be a new layer of indirection or a reduction in performance.

— Zach Kehs , There's No Limit to How Bad Code Can Get
summaryZh: 该内容为博主引用的软件工程观点，讨论代码复杂度和技术债问题，不涉及大模型研发或应用。
